description: This source file provides utility functions for converting between BSP internal variables and SLAP variables, including handling of scalar, array, bulk data, and object types. It supports conversion in both directions and manages SLAP parameter lists, property parameters, and comparison values.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_VC_Var2Slap(ANSC_HANDLE hVar,ANSC_HANDLE hSlapVar)
methods.description: Converts a BSP variable handle to a SLAP variable handle, handling different BSP variable types including number, string, object, array, and bulk data.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_VC_Slap2Var(ANSC_HANDLE hSlapVar,ANSC_HANDLE hVar)
methods.description: Converts a SLAP variable handle into a BSP variable handle, supporting various SLAP types including basic types, arrays, objects, and fallback case for general objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_PrepBspArrayVar(ANSC_HANDLE hArrayVar,ULONG ulItems,BSP_TEMPLATE_ARRAY_TYPE arrayItemType)
methods.description: Prepares a BSP array variable with specified items count and type, allocating necessary memory and handling bulk data or individual elements.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_VC_PrepareSlapParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hSlapParamList,ANSC_HANDLE hVars,ULONG ulVars)
methods.description: Converts an array of BSP variable handles into a SLAP parameter list for function calls.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_VC_DeleteSlapParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hSlapParamList)
methods.description: Cleans up a SLAP parameter list, freeing resources allocated for the parameter list.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_PreparePropertyParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hRuntime,ANSC_HANDLE hSlapParamList,BOOL bGetProperty,PUCHAR pPropertyName,ANSC_HANDLE hPropertyValue)
methods.description: Prepares a property get/set parameter list with property name and value variables.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_GetSlapVarCompareValue(ANSC_HANDLE hSlapVar,ANSC_HANDLE hCompareValue)
methods.description: Extracts a comparable value from a SLAP variable for comparison purposes, supporting various types.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_VC_VarArray2Slap(ANSC_HANDLE hVar,ANSC_HANDLE hSlapVar)
methods.description: Converts a BSP variable array to a SLAP array variable, supporting multiple array formats with various element types.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspEng_VC_BulkData2Slap(ANSC_HANDLE hVar,ANSC_HANDLE hSlapVar)
methods.description: Converts bulk data stored in a BSP array variable to a SLAP array variable, handling different element types and memory copying.
